fusions.name: Sic 'Em
fusions.desc: Points a hound at the first enemy in its path: it deals 13 damage and knocks the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Two-Finger Whistle
fusions.desc: A piercing whistle through your fingers deals 25 resonating damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Good Fetch
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Eats from Your Palm
fusions.desc: Calls a hound familiar that fights beside you, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each bite slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.
